# The Business Partner Beside the Name — finished platform kit

## 1. LONG VIDEO
Keep the founder’s public portrait on one side while operational decisions accumulate on the other; attach a record to every authority claim.

## 2. SHORT 01
“The person not on the label may be carrying the institution.” Name six forms of capacity without guessing ownership.

## 3. SHORT 02
Title, vote, equity, approval, information, and trust are six different controls.

## 4. CAROUSEL
Work; authority; record; money; information; refusal; deadlock; departure; continuity.

## 5. AUDIO
A partner-to-partner decision interview with separate factual, disputed, and counsel-review fields.

## 6. BEEHIIV / LINKEDIN / PINTEREST
Essay, governance argument, and nine diagram-led pins; no private agreement is implied by public imagery.

## Claim ledger
- **VERIFIED:** Board, executive, voting, economic, and creative authority are distinct fields in public corporate records. (S36, S37, S50, S51, S52)
- **INFERENCE:** A public title does not establish the full informal or contractual partnership. (S50, S51)

## Publication discipline
Do not invent production arrangements or add unlicensed imagery. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, evidence labels, labor and jurisdiction limits, participant correction, and counsel or specialist gates.
